rootCause: 旧 rollup 仅消费 CLOSED 1m，前端移除张数/基础币混算后显露较大周期不实时更新。
solution: 消费全部 1m 快照，用原 RocksDB accumulator 的一个可替换 activeMinute 尾部更新高周期，不新增 topic/index/线程；重复与旧快照去重，晚到 CLOSED 及 SQL 修订保留正确总量。

jfr.interpretation: 短采样包含启动后追赶，不能证明全链路零延迟或性能提升；所选监视器竞争最大值记录 Kafka consumer coordinator 等待。

initialFailures.preStopArtifactGuard: Maven -am also repackaged dependency executable; guard rejected before any service stopped. Retained all non-Realtime deployed executables and reverified.
initialFailures.firstBrowser: Six-second observation had two revisions; no passing claim.
initialFailures.secondBrowser: 5m assertion timed out during checkpoint catch-up, incoming late previous-bucket revisions while current bucket still lacked trades. Six periods rerun after catch-up passed.
initialFailures.priorCoverage: Earlier frontend public continuous-update check used only 1m; it did not establish all larger periods updating.

knownLatency: Existing Streams commit interval 1s, minute and rollup topic feedback adds transaction visibility waits. Correlated lastTradeId receive difference, not end-to-end latency; detailed P95/max in probe. No zero-delay claim.

testedScope.server: LINEAR_PERPETUAL BTC/ETH/SOL; public read-only WS/HTTP and Chrome actual series
testedScope.unit: all 6 ProductLine values; all 11 higher periods; 28 tests
